eyebrow: Partitioning by date — the classic default
code:
FactOrders/
  order_date=2024-01-01/  part-0000.parquet

caption: Lines the physical layout up with how the table gets queried.

code:
SELECT SUM(total_amount)
FROM FactOrders
WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-31';
-- Only January's partitions get opened at all
caption: Scanning a month, not scanning 10 billion rows.

code:
By second:  billions of tiny partitions -- pruning barely helps
By year:    a few huge partitions -- pruning can't narrow enough
By date:    matches the real query pattern, small enough to prune
caption: Over-partitioning and under-partitioning are both real mistakes.
